snippet.title: Megan Moon
snippet.description:
Welcome to Megan Moon 🌙

Hey, I’m Megan. After more than a decade living in South Korea, I create honest, thought-provoking videos about human behavior, relationships, and the cultural patterns that shape how we live and connect.

This channel goes beyond surface-level content to explore the things people don’t always talk about—why we act the way we do, why certain situations feel “off,” and how to navigate life with more awareness and intention.

Some videos are rooted in my experience living in Korea, while others explore universal social dynamics that apply anywhere in the world.

If you’re curious about people, relationships, culture, and living a more thoughtful, balanced life—you’re in the right place.

Subscribe and join the conversation ✨
